text:
Maya: heads-up — we hit ~1.8k early SSE closes from proxy -> backend (tcp RST) in last 20m on prod-eu. Console is showing per-route quota errors too. https://console.internal/streams/stream-42 :eyes:

Theo: logs?

Maya: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-12T10:11:22Z] proxy: conn 0x7f12 -> backend 10.0.3.45:443 RST after 3s, bytes_sent=128
[2026-03-12T10:11:23Z] sse: client 1234 stream_id=abc closed early code=ECONNRESET
```

Sam: that's odd — the proxy should translate RSTs to 5xx; why is it leaking as early close? could be socket half-close path in our streaming mux.

Jess: seeing similar in us-west-1, but metrics show quota throttle spikes at same minute. Possibly quota enforcer is cancelling streams mid-handshake.

anil: quoted console trace: `/routes/stream-42` had per-route token_bucket drop to 0 then `cancel_stream()` fired. attaching graph: https://console.internal/metrics/graph?id=xyz

Maya: attaching sample curl reproduce:
```
curl -H "Accept:text/event-stream" -v https://api.redwood.test/stream-42 | head -n 5
# sometimes returns 'HTTP/1.1 200' then immediate connection close
```

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-12T09:50 -> prod-eu (proxy v2.14) completed :white_check_mark:

Theo: hypothesis: quota enforcer calls `shutdown_write()` on upstream when bucket exhausted; kernel then emits RST to client if write buffer state inconsistent. We should avoid upstream half-close during SSE active sessions.

Sam: quick fix idea: change enforcer to `drain_and_pause()` instead of immediate cancel for SSE content-type; maybe per-route policy where content-type=text/event-stream gets grace window.

Jess: UX note: console should flag streams that were cancelled due to quota vs network RST. Right now both show as 'early_close' and hard to disambiguate.

Maya: agree. Priorities: 1) confirm if enforcer is root cause (anil + Sam) 2) instrument proxy to log enforcer-induced closes 3) console update to break out reasons (Jess).

anil: on it, will add tag `enforcer_reason` to proxy logs and roll a tiny canary to prod-eu.

Sam: I'll sketch code change and open PR. If we can't avoid RST, fallback policy should be to return 429 body and graceful close, not raw connection reset.

Jess: ping @console-bot when you have telemetry changes so I can add a dashboard panel.

console-bot: ack — will create ephemeral panel 'stream-early-closes-by-reason' and notify channel when ready.

Maya: thanks everyone. adding to follow-up doc: https://docs.internal/streaming-incidents/1823456789

Sam: PR 9876 opened: draft; marking WIP.

Maya: will coordinate canary after PR lands. :thumbsup:
